name: Salem Health Student Volunteers
what_you_do: High school students help staff, visitors and patients at the hospital after school or in summer. They learn about health care.
who_can_apply: Students at least 14 years old from Marion and Polk county school districts. The page lists a questionnaire, references and an essay as application steps.
duration: School year: one shift a week, September to June. Summer: two shifts a week for eight weeks, June to August.
deadline_text: Application windows: school year July 1 to July 15; summer April 15 to May 1. The page does not give a year for these windows.
how_to_apply: Send in the high school student form. Then finish a questionnaire and reference form. The page also mentions an essay and maybe an interview in person.
notes: The general page asks volunteers to commit to a weekly shift for a year. The page does not list a shift time or hours beyond the weekly and summer commitments.
